svg.title: Veylqorix — how the gate works
svg.desc: A target is accepted, the project detected, four real scanners run, findings are normalized into one schema, and the deterministic gate returns PASS, FAIL or INCOMPLETE on every surface.
svg.text: deterministic code-security gate · real evidence, no fabrication
one target in · one verdict out
exit code is the contract · a gap is never a clean pass
